title: Generic dichotomy for a section component
statement: For schemes P and T with noetherian structures, a locally finitely presented, quasi-compact, quasi-separated morphism g : P ⟶ T and section σ with σ ≫ g = 𝟙 T, and every irreducible closed set Z ⊆ P, there is an open U meeting Z such that U ∩ Z is contained in the section component locus or in its complement. Locally finite presentation is used as in [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation].

source.place: Stacks Project, Tag 055P, final paragraph using 055N and 055M

proof.text: Take a generic point x of the irreducible closed set Z, using scheme sobriety (QuasiSober.sober). Apply generic clopenness at the base point g(x). This gives an open V of T containing g(x) on which the section locus is clopen inside the inverse image of V intersect closure {g(x)}.
Set U = g inverse image V. It is open, and x belongs to U intersect Z. Directly apply the defining open-intersection property of IsPreirreducible Z to show that U intersect Z is preirreducible.

Every q in Z is a specialization of x; continuity of g implies that g(q) belongs to closure {g(x)}. Therefore the inclusion of U intersect Z into the subspace used by generic clopenness is defined and continuous. Pull back the clopen section locus along this inclusion. A preirreducible space is preconnected, so isClopen_iff says that this pullback is empty or the whole subspace. In the empty case U intersect Z is contained in the complement of the section locus; in the whole case it is contained in the section locus.

proof_origin.note: Q1 formalized the generic-point, open-intersection, continuous-subspace inclusion, and clopen dichotomy argument. Only the scheme-theoretic shrinking assertion of Tag 055N remains in a new standalone module.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_open_section_component_dichotomy {P T : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian P] [IsNoetherian T] (g : P ⟶ T)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation g] [QuasiCompact g] [QuasiSeparated g]
    (σ : T ⟶ P) (hσ : σ ≫ g = 𝟙 T) (Z : Set P)
    (hZ : IsClosed Z) (hZi : IsIrreducible Z) :
    ∃ U : Set P, IsOpen U ∧ (U ∩ Z).Nonempty ∧
      (U ∩ Z ⊆ {q : P | q ∈ connectedComponentIn (g ⁻¹' {g q}) (σ (g q))} ∨
       U ∩ Z ⊆ {q : P | q ∈ connectedComponentIn (g ⁻¹' {g q}) (σ (g q))}ᶜ)
